entries.observation: The symbolic/binary boundary had already been partially engineered in resident artifacts before this run.
entries.effect: Work was treated as recovered baseline, not claimed as new implementation.
entries.rectification: Integrated resident IL-LLM semantics and newer independent-process Report 03 V3 instead of duplicating the earlier package.

entries.observation: R4 combined clean execution exceeded the command execution window, while isolated distributed tests completed.
entries.effect: Stored R4 PASS receipt was not used as proof of this rerun.
entries.rectification: Qualified current R5 using separately exiting suites and current source.

entries.observation: A monolithic 63-test invocation printed successful assertions but failed to exit cleanly after repeated multiprocessing teardown.
entries.effect: The invocation was not counted as a completed PASS.
entries.rectification: Qualification is three independent exit-code-checked suites; aggregate passes only if each process exits 0.

entries.observation: A failed one-triad minority prepare left uncommitted conflicting entries that blocked a later valid proposal at the same log index.
entries.effect: Minority failure could poison liveness despite preserving committed-state safety.
entries.rectification: Replica append now permits supersession only for uncommitted entries from a strictly lower term and only when the new proposal extends the committed head. Same-term conflict remains fenced. Added regression test test_08b.

entries.observation: Project-local deterministic JSON serializes 1e-7 as 1e-07 while ECMAScript JSON.stringify emits 1e-7.
entries.effect: Cross-language canonical hashes differ; RFC 8785/JCS compatibility is false for the observed input.
entries.rectification: Report forbids JCS conformance claim and specifies canonicalization replacement as missing architecture.

entries.observation: A/B encoding is workload-dependent. Uniform zero bytes selected KEX_AB; alternating 0xAA bytes selected RAW_BINARY.
entries.effect: A/B cannot be promoted as universal compression.
entries.rectification: Adaptive boundary selects representation by payload size and keeps semantic identity independent from representation.

entries.observation: Resident IL-LLM recovered adapter contains 1084 lexicon entries, but 2 are marked DEGRADED_SOURCE.
entries.effect: Semantic source completeness/cleanliness is not universal.
entries.rectification: require_clean=True fails closed for degraded entries; full corpus repair remains explicit.

entries.observation: The HTML manifestation was externally replaced with visual drift.
entries.effect: Projection bytes changed while accepted semantic state did not.
entries.rectification: Layer-2 detected REPLACE and restored the exact accepted HTML hash without changing semantic_digest.

entries.observation: Binary payload mutation changed packet bytes.
entries.rectification: SHA-256 payload digest check rejected the packet with BOUNDARY_PAYLOAD_DIGEST_MISMATCH.

entries.observation: A valid packet was decoded under the wrong expected semantic digest.
entries.effect: Representation could otherwise be detached from its semantic authority.
entries.rectification: Semantic digest prefix binding rejected it with SEMANTIC_DIGEST_PREFIX_MISMATCH.

entries.observation: Accepted directory metadata semantic_digest was maliciously patched to a different value.
entries.effect: The accepted object no longer matched the resident semantic concept.
entries.rectification: Binary lowering failed closed at verify_accepted before substrate materialization.
